answer_2.quote: To quantify model refusals, we adopt a keyword-based detection approach... refusal rate is then computed as the proportion of inputs for which the model returns a refusal response. We compute the Attack Success Rate (ASR) as the proportion of adversarial prompts that elicit model responses aligned with the harmful intent of the input.

answer_3.quote: We compute the Attack Success Rate (ASR)... utilizing the GPT-Fuzz module from EasyJailbreak's Evaluator suite to automatically assess whether the generated content is malicious or policy-violating.
